answer: Make each identity keep a private, evolving notebook with the network: every epoch a random examiner holds a short sealed dialogue with the key and later asks follow-ups that only make sense given that key's own past exchanges, like asking which pearl it chose to hide last spring. Answers must stay consistent with its whole history. One operator running many keys has to maintain a separate coherent atlas of memories for each; any slip, or two keys recalling each other's details, lights a lantern on the pair and freezes their rewards.
